title: Robe of Supreme Defences
summary: While concentrating, add your spellcasting modifier to saves and gain +1 AC.

fields.Exquisite Focus: While concentrating, add your spellcasting ability modifier to saving throws and gain +1 Armour Class.
fields.Acquisition: Ferg Drogher’s special stock in Rivington, near the Requisitioned Barn. A Persuasion check can unlock it. He will not trade with Shadowheart nearby unless she killed Aylin in Act Two, in which case no Persuasion check is needed.

changes: Added native BG3 rules using pinned item and linked gameplay sources.
